{"mimeType": "text/markdown", "text": "# match3d-backend - prod deploys
How prod works for the ZM backend since the prod env went up (match3d-backend#2).

Merging doesn't deploy anything. Dev is deployed by hand from main. Prod runs from the prod branch: to put a PR on prod you cherry-pick it onto prod, build a new zm-api task definition revision and update the service (steps on the CI/CD Pipeline & Branching page). Only the PRs picked onto prod are on prod.

Whoever deploys a PR to prod comments on that PR with a line starting "prod:", the time in UTC and the task definition. That comment is what puts the PR on prod, not the merge and not a Slack message.

A prod deploy only counts if the PR already had an Approve review from someone other than its author when it went out. Approving afterwards doesn't fix it; redeploy.

To roll back, revert the pick on prod, redeploy and comment "rollback:" on the PR. A rollback takes the PR off prod whenever it happens, freeze or not, until a newer "prod:" comment.

Console changes and spreadsheet imports have no PR: they go in the deploy log, Console & imports tab, with what changed or what was imported, the target (dev or prod) and the time.

Freezes: from the server freeze on the calendar until the beta ships, the Approve review has to be Arthur's. Anything else deployed during the freeze gets rolled back at go/no-go.

The deploy log also has a Prod deploys tab as a quick list.
", "id": "f_470ae81236d5bd39045dc1", "name": "match3d-backend - prod deploys"}

content.text:
I've done the server side of the beta sign-off. The result: 18 tickets are in scope, 10 are on prod and 8 aren't.

**The register:** "ZM Beta sign-off - server side register" is in Arthur's ZM Beta sign-off folder. It has one row per ticket with the ticket, its server change(s), on prod Y/N, and a note on why. I followed the rules on Arthur's Trello card, plus his comment there that spreadsheet imports count as server changes. Whether something is on prod comes from the prod deploys doc: a "prod:" comment on the PR (or a prod entry in the deploy log for imports), an approval from someone other than the author before the deploy, Arthur's approval during the freeze (from Sep 26 22:00 UTC), and no rollback after the last deploy.

- **On prod (10):** ZOM-459, 509, 510, 531, 537, 444, 499, 487, 547, 553.
- **Not on prod (8):**
  - ZOM-336 (#40) and ZOM-435 (#51) only ever went to dev.
  - ZOM-392 (#41) was approved only after its prod deploy.
  - ZOM-518 (#43) went to prod with no approval.
  - ZOM-256's Algo Levels 2.0 level pack was only imported to dev.
  - ZOM-550 (#50) went out during the freeze without Arthur's approval. His review only says "ship it after go/no-go".
  - ZOM-503: #42 is on prod, but #52 went out during the freeze without Arthur's approval.
  - ZOM-557 (#54) was rolled back on Sep 28.

**Tickets:** Arthur's rule 5 says anything not on prod goes back to Todo, so I moved all 8 back. Each one has a comment saying which change still has to go out.

**Arthur:** I replied in your DM with the counts and both lists. I also added one correction: on Sep 22 you told him the trophy path double-claim fix was out, but #51 never got past dev.

**Leonard:** I shared the register with him directly with comment access, as he asked.

Two more things you should know:
- A Sep 27 QA message in Slack says "all the server fixes we closed since the cut are on prod". The PR records show that's wrong.
- Under the freeze rules, #50 and #52 are on prod right now but not properly approved, so they'll be rolled back at go/no-go. That takes the boss arena lives fix and the teams lives refresh off prod.

One judgement call: ZOM-461 was closed at 11:51 on Aug 25, a minute before the beta prod cut at 11:52, so I left it out of scope. ZOM-459 was closed at 11:53 and is in.
